description.value:
Duration constant

When you would gain Cinders from a qualifying act of destruction — breaking what should be broken, unmaking a work, ending something that was holding on — you progress toward your next point as though you had performed two such acts. This does not raise your cap and does not apply to qualifying acts of other kinds.

cinderfall.incomplete: STRUCT-GAIN-HOOK: SpecialResource (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts) tracks a pool's current value and max but has no 'rate multiplier' concept for a narrative-triggered gain -- gain is entirely manual (confirmed by fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own card text: 'Vitae is gathered, not granted... you refill the pool through grim ritual').
